text: hey i got a real one for ya that is already annoying. but there is in the world editor control the ability to go up and down floors, and the cursor to ghost/wireframe sync is perfect on the ground level, the moment you go up one it completely desyncs and progressively gets worse as you go
resolution: Root-caused the upper-floor cursor-to-ghost desync: the host placement pick door (__compiled_world_ground_hit) always raycast the painted TERRAIN with no idea a storey was active, while resolvePlacement based the piece at terrainY + floor*3m — so on Floor 1+ the ghost projected exactly one storey's iso slant away from the cursor, growing per floor. Fix is Zig-first: the door now accepts an optional levelY (metres) and intersects the terrain surface lifted by it, implemented by lowering the ray origin (the heightfield march itself never learns what a storey is); returned y stays true terrain height and the cart adds the storey back. Brush/paint paths pass 0. WorldViewport passes floor*METERS_PER_LEVEL through groundUnder, so snap, box ghost, mesh ghost, and the POS readout all land under the cursor on every floor. Needs a host rebuild (Zig change) to take effect.
